case.summary: Investigation HHG-018 was initiated following a customer report from C02354 denying transaction 3491361 ($39.08) on card C02354-K2. The transaction occurred in-person in billing region 126 on 2016-11-27. Although the card has a history of purchases in region 126, the customer confirmed they did not make this purchase, still possess the card, and have not authorized others to use it. This cardholder has experienced four other confirmed out-of-region fraud episodes in the last 120 days (CC-4942, CC-4721, CC-4436, and CC-3537). Based on the customer's denial and prior fraud history, the transaction is confirmed as fraud under the out_of_region_use pattern.
